responsibility: Declares the Rust FFI surface for the LLVM backend module, including ABI-compatible enum and struct definitions plus extern bindings to rustc’s LLVM wrapper and LLVM C APIs that are used for code generation, diagnostics, archives, module flags, LTO, linking, and object inspection.
same_name_distinction: Unlike `coverageinfo/ffi.rs`, this FFI file is the broad backend binding layer: it defines raw LLVM-facing enums, opaque types, and extern functions for the wrapper/C APIs across code generation, diagnostics, archives, LTO, linking, and debuginfo. It is not limited to coverage metadata layouts or MIR-coverage-to-ABI conversion.
